indentation._comment: Off: Fantomas owns layout and this rule fights it. The tree is Fantomas-clean (fantomas --check exits 0) and the 4,236 findings (2026-10-18) are Fantomas's own output: 3-space-aligned anonymous-record fields, object expressions, interpolated-string continuations. Reformatting a sample to the rule's 4-space shape and re-running Fantomas restores the flagged layout, so no whitespace fix survives format-on-save.

maxCharactersOnLine._comment: Off: Fantomas owns line breaking at the same 120 columns. The tree is Fantomas-clean; of the 785 longer lines (2026-10-18), 623 are string literals and 23 are comments, which Fantomas cannot break. The rest are lines Fantomas chose to leave long.

maxLinesInFile._comment: Off: refactoring backlog. 51 finding(s) on main (2026-10-18); reaching 0 means splitting files, modules, classes or signatures, which is structural work tracked separately, not a lint sweep.

trailingNewLineInFile._comment: Off: Fantomas owns layout and this rule fights it. Despite its name it flags the single final newline every file ends with (444 findings, 2026-10-18), which Fantomas always writes: strip it and Fantomas puts it back.

redundantNewKeyword._comment: Off: it fights the compiler. It flags `new` on IDisposable types declared in another project of this solution (SpawnHelper.Connection, Watchdog, SessionRegistry, PollingFileWatcher: 10 of its 14 findings, 2026-10-18), and dropping `new` there is FS0760, an error under TreatWarningsAsErrors. Its true positives (BCL TaskCompletionSource and Thread) were fixed.

maxLinesInFunction._comment: Off: 2 finding(s) in 2 file(s) on main when enabled (shim-path lint, 2026-10-18). Follow-up: fix or deliberately suppress them, then enable.

maxLinesInModule._comment: Off: refactoring backlog. 74 finding(s) on main (2026-10-18); reaching 0 means splitting files, modules, classes or signatures, which is structural work tracked separately, not a lint sweep.

maxLinesInClass._comment: Off: refactoring backlog. 1 finding(s) on main (2026-10-18); reaching 0 means splitting files, modules, classes or signatures, which is structural work tracked separately, not a lint sweep.

recordFieldNames._comment: Off by design. 26 of its 27 findings (2026-10-18) are private record representations, Verdict and RunVerdict, whose camelCase fields back PascalCase members of the same name and are reachable only through a validating constructor. PascalCase fields would collide with those members, so the fix would rename one side for the linter alone. The one public camelCase field (IdleExit.FireLatch.state) was renamed.

publicValuesNames._comment: Off: 36 public constants (2026-10-18), e.g. Heartbeat.DefaultCadence, SafeWalk.SourceExcludedDirs. Renaming them is public-API churn that conflicts with parallel FsHotWatch work; revisit when no FsHotWatch changes are in flight.

patternMatchClauseIndentation._comment: Off: Fantomas owns layout and this rule fights it. Its findings (83, 2026-10-18) are clause layouts in the Fantomas-clean tree, e.g. a parenthesised match inside a && chain. Fantomas is idempotent, so any whitespace-only re-indent of a clause is reverted on the next format.

favourTypedIgnore._comment: Off: not wanted. 2,242 findings (2026-10-18), essentially every `|> ignore` in the tree. Annotating each ignore with its type is a sweep whose cost outweighs the partial-application mistakes it would catch.

maxNumberOfFunctionParameters._comment: Off: 70 finding(s) in 24 file(s) on main when enabled (shim-path lint, 2026-10-18). Follow-up: fix or deliberately suppress them, then enable.

maxNumberOfMembers._comment: Off: 28 finding(s) in 21 file(s) on main when enabled (shim-path lint, 2026-10-18). Follow-up: fix or deliberately suppress them, then enable.

Array.map f (Array.map g x) ===> Array.map (g >> f) x
